_comment: Layout and motion for bottom-sheet. Colours come from the Figma colour mirror (colors/bottom sheet); these do not. VERIFIED against Figma component set `Bottom sheet` (20052:11505) on 2026-08-19 — the first build guessed several of these from the Frontend and got them wrong; see _corrections.

_source.handle-width: 54x4 with a 2.5px radius, measured from the Rectangle inside `Bottom sheet/Handlebar`. Not on any DS scale — the handle is a hit target people aim at, so it is kept verbatim rather than rounded to a spacing step.
_source.handle-icon-size: The handlebar row carries optional 16px leading and trailing icons in Figma. semantic.iconography.sizes is still 'tbd', so nothing backs this.
_source.max-height: A viewport unit, so no spacing token applies. `dvh` rather than `vh` so mobile browser chrome does not clip the sheet.
_source.dismiss-threshold: Drag distance in px past which the sheet closes. An interaction constant, not a design token.
_source.transition-duration: storybook-local — design.md has no motion group at any tier.

_corrections.elevation: REMOVED. The first build bound elevation.modal. The Figma component carries no effect at all — `effects: []` — so the sheet reads against the scrim, not against a shadow.
_corrections.handle-radius: Was radius.full (9999). Figma draws 2.5, which is exactly half of a 4px bar — the same shape, but stated rather than approximated.
_corrections.handle-colour: Was foreground-gray (#A3A3A3), guessed from the token name. Figma binds `bottom sheet-fg-dark` (#000000) — the Frontend was right and the guess was wrong.
_corrections.handle-padding: Was 12 top / 8 bottom. Figma's Handlebar has 12 on both, and 16 on the sides.

_verified_from.result: Corrected against Figma in an earlier pass; see `_corrections`. The component carries no effect at all (`effects: []`), the handle is 54x4 with a 2.5 radius, and padding is 12/16.

_figma_icons._comment: The icons Figma instantiates for this component, read 2026-08-20 by walking the instance tree and keeping every main component whose parent set is `icons`. An icon Figma hides by default belongs in `icons` only when this component implements the state that reveals it; otherwise it is recorded under _figma_gaps instead, so the gate is not asking for a feature nobody built.

nodes.note: Neither variant draws an icon: `Bottom sheet/Handlebar` holds two 16px `icons-size` wrappers whose own `visible` is false, so only the 54x4 bar shows. See _figma_gaps > handlebar-has-two-hidden-icon-slots.

_figma_gaps.handlebar-has-two-hidden-icon-slots: `Bottom sheet/Handlebar` (inside 20052:11505, both Modal=True and Modal=False) carries two 16px icon slots either side of the drag bar — `filled-Home` on the left at x=0 and `filled-close` on the right at x=342 — each wrapped in an `icons-size` instance whose `visible` is false. The design has drawn a header row for the sheet and switched it off. The library renders the bar alone, which matches every variant as shipped. If that row is meant to exist, Figma needs a variant that shows it, and these two move into _figma_icons. Read 2026-08-20.
